data.name: WindowTitle
data.value: Shaft Stock Distributor — by Hannes Hold

data.name: Tagline
data.value: Plan, simulate, and control returnable-crate shafts

data.name: ConfigurationLocked
data.value: Stop or reset the simulation to edit the configuration.

data.name: LoadExampleBody
data.value: The current project has unsaved changes. Loading the example warehouse replaces the layout, articles, and assignment.

data.name: ReoptimizedForLayout
data.value: The assignment did not match the layout, so this project was optimized again.

data.name: ModeConfirmBody
data.value: Automatic mode may retarget only empty shafts. Pinned shafts stay as they are. A shaft that still holds crates is never reassigned.

data.name: ShuttleZoneHint
data.value: Each shuttle serves a segment range. Neighbours may overlap; the overlap is shared and uses collision avoidance. A lower-numbered shuttle stays left of the next one, so they never pass. Every segment needs at least one shuttle. Speed defaults to 0.3 m/s.

data.name: ShuttleLimit
data.value: This layout has {0} segments, so it can hold at most {0} shuttles.

data.name: EvenSplitApplied
data.value: Ranges were split evenly across {0} shuttles. Apply layout to keep them.

data.name: ThirdsPresetApplied
data.value: Two-shuttle thirds preset is ready. Apply layout to keep the shared middle.

data.name: ClickShaft
data.value: Click a shaft to assign an article or pin it.

data.name: GeneratorHint
data.value: Each article takes a configured crate type. A movers get a higher demand than B movers, and B higher than C. The shaft assignment is cleared so you can optimize again.

data.name: GeneratorPercentSum
data.value: A, B, and C percentages must add up to 100%.

data.name: GeneratorCount
data.value: Enter an article count from 1 to 2000.

data.name: GeneratorSeed
data.value: Seed must be a whole number, or leave it blank.

data.name: GeneratorReplaceBody
data.value: This removes the current articles and clears the shaft assignment. The layout and scenarios stay as they are.

data.name: GeneratedArticles
data.value: Generated {0} articles (A {1}, B {2}, C {3}). The shaft assignment was cleared. Run the optimizer to place them.

data.name: InflowUpdated
data.value: Inflow updated for {0}. Playback restarted so arrivals use the new rate. Run the optimizer if the shaft plan should follow this demand.

data.name: DemoHint
data.value: Run simulation plays the current project. Load example project restores the sample warehouse.

data.name: PlaybackReset
data.value: Playback was reset to the start.

data.name: CannotReassignFilled
data.value: That shaft still holds crates, so its article was left unchanged.

data.name: Validation_Positive
data.value: Enter a number greater than zero.

data.name: Validation_NonNegative
data.value: Enter zero or a positive number.

data.name: UpperBoundTip
data.value: Mean travel between shafts a shuttle can serve, plus the transfer, times the most pallets one pull can discharge. The next pull starts at the last shaft, not at home. Shared-zone waiting is ignored, so this is an upper bound.

data.name: Validation_PullNeverTriggers
data.value: Article '{0}' never reaches a pull. One shaft holds {1} crates, but a pull needs {2} (pallet {3} + offset {4}).

data.name: Validation_CrossSection
data.value: Article '{0}' does not fit the shaft cross-section ({1} m by {2} m).

data.name: Validation_ScenarioShares
data.value: Scenario '{0}' shares sum to {1}, not 100%. They are scaled to 100% when the scenario is applied.

data.name: Validation_ShuttleSpeed
data.value: {0} needs a {1} speed greater than zero.

data.name: Validation_ShaftLength
data.value: Shaft length must be greater than zero.

data.name: Validation_SegmentCount
data.value: Segment count must be at least 1.

data.name: Validation_LevelAboveTypical
data.value: This layout has more than 5 levels. The usual rack has at most 5.

data.name: Validation_ShaftAboveTypical
data.value: This layout has more than 9 shafts on a level. The usual rack has at most 9.

data.name: Validation_AddressOutsideLayout
data.value: Shaft {0} is outside the current layout.

data.name: Validation_AssignmentIncomplete
data.value: The assignment does not cover every shaft in the layout.

data.name: Validation_ShuttleCount
data.value: This layout has {0} segments, so it can hold at most {0} shuttles.

data.name: Validation_DuplicateShuttle
data.value: Shuttle {0} is listed more than once.

data.name: Validation_ShuttleRange
data.value: Shuttle {0} covers segments {1}–{2}, which is outside this layout (segments 1–{3}).

data.name: Validation_ShuttleOrder
data.value: Shuttle {0} (segments {1}–{2}) crosses shuttle {3} (segments {4}–{5}). Shuttles cannot pass, so ranges must stay in aisle order.

data.name: Validation_ShuttleCoverageGap
data.value: Segment {0} is not covered by any shuttle.

data.name: Validation_ShuttleHomeOrder
data.value: Shuttle {0} home ({1} m) is left of shuttle {2} ({3} m). Homes must follow aisle order.

data.name: Validation_ShuttleHomeSpacing
data.value: Shuttle {0} and shuttle {1} homes are {2} m apart. They must stay at least {3} m apart.

data.name: TipNew
data.value: Start a blank project. Disabled while a simulation is running or paused.

data.name: TipOpen
data.value: Open a project file. Disabled while a simulation is running or paused.

data.name: TipSave
data.value: Save the current project as JSON.

data.name: TipLoadExample
data.value: Replace this project with the example warehouse. Asks first if there are unsaved changes.

data.name: TipExportJson
data.value: Save the shaft assignment as JSON.

data.name: TipExportCsv
data.value: Save the shaft assignment as CSV.

data.name: TipMode
data.value: Ask to switch between automatic and manual assignment.

data.name: TipRunSimulation
data.value: Open Live demo and play this project. Re-optimizes only if the assignment does not match the layout.

data.name: TipStop
data.value: Pause the simulation. Available only while it is running.

data.name: TipContinue
data.value: Resume a paused simulation from the same time.

data.name: TipResetSimulation
data.value: Return playback to the start. Does not load the example.

data.name: TipConfirmMode
data.value: Switch mode. Automatic may retarget empty shafts only. A filled shaft stays.

data.name: TipConfirmLoadExample
data.value: Discard unsaved changes and load the example warehouse.

data.name: TipNavLive
data.value: Open the live aisle, playback, and shaft assignment.

data.name: TipNavLayout
data.value: Open the rack size and shuttle zones.

data.name: TipNavArticles
data.value: Open crate types and the article generator.

data.name: TipNavOperation
data.value: Open the pull queue and event log.

data.name: TipPlay
data.value: Play from the current time. Continues if playback is already paused.

data.name: TipPause
data.value: Pause playback. Available only while it is running.

data.name: TipStep
data.value: Advance to the next event, then pause.

data.name: TipResetPlayback
data.value: Return playback to time zero. Available after play has started.

data.name: TipApplyScenario
data.value: Write the selected scenario onto article inflows and restart playback.

data.name: TipApplyShaft
data.value: Assign the chosen article and pin to the selected shaft. A filled shaft keeps its article.

data.name: TipSelectShaft
data.value: Click a shaft to select it for assignment.

data.name: TipAddShuttle
data.value: Add a shuttle and split the aisle evenly. At most one shuttle per segment.

data.name: TipRemoveShuttle
data.value: Remove one shuttle and split the aisle evenly. At least one shuttle stays.

data.name: TipEvenSplit
data.value: Divide the segments evenly across the shuttles in the table.

data.name: TipTwoShuttleThirds
data.value: Set two shuttles that share the middle third. Press Apply layout to keep it.

data.name: TipApplyLayout
data.value: Save the rack and the shuttle table, then reset playback.

data.name: TipAddArticle
data.value: Add a blank article and select it for editing.

data.name: TipRemoveArticle
data.value: Remove the selected article and clear shafts that used it.

data.name: TipGenerate
data.value: Build articles from the crate types. Asks before replacing an existing list.

data.name: TipReplaceArticles
data.value: Replace the article list and clear the shaft assignment.

data.name: TipApplyArticle
data.value: Write this form onto the selected article. A grid inflow edit is kept, and playback restarts.

data.name: TipRunOptimizer
data.value: Search for a lower-cost assignment and replace the current plan.

data.name: TipCancelOptimizer
data.value: Stop the search. The assignment already on the project stays.

data.name: TipRunStudy
data.value: Sweep the load range and plot achieved pallets per hour.

data.name: TipCancelStudy
data.value: Stop the study. Points already finished stay on the chart.

data.name: TipExportResults
data.value: Save the study table as CSV. Does nothing until a study has finished.

data.name: TipAddScenario
data.value: Add a scenario at 1,800 crates per hour. This page does not show a list.

data.name: TipRemoveScenario
data.value: Remove the scenario you just added, or the first one if you have not added one.

data.name: TipHeatmap
data.value: Color shafts by how often they have been pulled.

data.name: TipPin
data.value: Keep this shaft when automatic mode retargets empty shafts.

data.name: TipReplaceExisting
data.value: Ask before replacing the current article list. Off appends the new articles.

data.name: TipReoptimize
data.value: Assign shafts again for each scenario and load before simulating it.

data.name: TipCompareModes
data.value: Run every load in both manual and automatic assignment.

data.name: TipLostRule
data.value: Treat any lost crate as saturation.
